title: Edmund and the Monsoon
author: Juniper Montrose
blurb: August Ravensworth, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
